name: ROK trilateral IT-worker policy chronology

attribution.legal_posture: Official meeting and policy-coordination notice; underlying assessments, enforcement action, sanctions designation, criminal allegation, and adjudication status remain unreported.

caveats: The meeting record supplies the meeting context; contents, evidentiary basis, and conclusions of the shared assessments remain unreported.
Government representatives named in the source are omitted from this dataset's threat-actor, facilitator, and case-subject records.
This notice overlaps prior trilateral policy activity and adds a fifth-meeting chronology point; underlying-conduct corroboration requires separate evidence.

statements: An official June 2026 meeting notice supplies a chronology anchor for the fifth trilateral diplomatic working-group discussion of DPRK cyber threats.
The notice identifies IT-worker activity as an agenda category alongside other illicit cyber activity and records policy coordination, without publishing the assessments shared.
infrastructure.evidence_boundary: A meeting notice establishes policy chronology and discussion scope only. It is not evidence of a specific placement, operation, employer, worker, victim, sanction, prosecution, labor measure, or immigration action.

sources.support: Supports only the chronology and policy-coordination claim: the fifth trilateral diplomatic working-group meeting occurred on June 25-26, 2026, and its agenda expressly included sharing assessments of DPRK IT-worker activity and discussing coordinated responses. It does not disclose the assessments, a specific operation, placement, employer, worker, victim, sanction, charge, labor action, or immigration action
sources.locator: Body paragraphs 1-3, especially paragraph 2 beginning '3국은 북한의 가상자산 탈취 및 세탁, IT 인력 활동 등'
